channel.title: SVG to Slides blog
channel.description: Google Slides design, and product marketing in Google Workspace.

item.title: Letter spacing survives the PDF. Kerning does too.
item.description: We set tracking on 10 Google Fonts at six sizes, exported to PDF and measured every letter.

item.title: Apps Script for GTM superpowers, part 1
item.description: Five scripts that turn Sheets into a launch control panel: a copy-length formula, one deck per account, follow-up drafts, a Monday digest and a change log. Slides, code and a cheat sheet.

item.title: Product screenshots go stale. Native UI mockups don't.
item.description: Every release breaks the screenshots in your decks. Build simplified product UI as native shapes and live text instead, kept in one library deck, and a renamed button is a find and replace.

item.title: Run a messaging workshop in Google Forms and build a brand style sheet in Google Sheets
item.description: A form collects the answers. One sheet turns them into messaging. A second sheet holds the brand's colours, type and voice in a form scripts and Gems can read.

item.title: Update Google Slides collateral from one messaging sheet with Gemini
item.description: Write the brief once in a sheet. Gemini writes each line to a recipe and a character limit, and a script puts it in every one-pager, brief, whitepaper and battlecard.

item.title: Google Slides finally does letter spacing
item.description: Tracking has landed in Slides. Here's what it is, how to use it well, and why Docs looks next.

item.title: Audit what Gemini's whole-deck edit changed
item.description: Gemini can now edit an entire presentation from one prompt. It tells you what it changed. Here is how to check, object by object, with a snapshot before and a diff after.

item.title: A competitor matrix where every cell cites its source
item.description: AI-filled competitive research was unusable because nobody could check it. As of this week, Fill with Gemini attaches a web source to each cell. Build the matrix around that.

item.title: On-brand charts in Slides, from Sheets data to native shapes
item.description: Sheets keeps adding chart types. None of them look like your brand once they're in a deck. Draw the chart as shapes instead, and every bar takes your colours and type.

item.title: Workspace Studio won't run on shared files. Design around it.
item.description: Studio flows fail on shared drives, shared folders and IMPORTRANGE. Messaging sheets are shared by definition. Here is the two-sheet pattern that works.

item.title: Turn your messaging recipes into Gemini skills
item.description: Skills are replacing Gems as the way to give Gemini standing instructions. Write your copy rules once and call them with @ in Docs, Slides and Gmail.

item.title: Customer proof points expire. Track them.
item.description: Logos, quotes and case studies come with permission, and permission has an end date. Keep a proof library in Sheets and get warned before a quote goes stale.

item.title: Find which slide draws the objections
item.description: Meet notes now capture the slide on screen. Log each objection against that slide and the weak spots in your deck show up in a week.

item.title: Certify reps on the new message with a Forms quiz
item.description: A launch isn't landed until the people selling it can say it. Build a short quiz from the messaging, score it in Sheets, and follow up with whoever missed.

item.title: Localize a one-pager without breaking the layout
item.description: Translations run long. Give every slot a budget per language, draft in Sheets, and catch the overflow before it reaches the page.
